module: "Audio Ribbon Editor" edit mode of the level editor: creates and edits sound "ribbons" (rivers, etc.) stored in the runtime module core/audioRibbon. A ribbon is a polyline of nodes with depth and speed; it carries either a single emitter ("Single Emitter Only") or four emitters (front, back, left, right) on the top surface, the bottom surface or the whole volume. The default events are 'event:>Ambient>Water>River'. The tool handles adding ribbons, moving nodes with the gizmo, snapping to the underlying surface (terrain, river, water plane), undo/redo through editor.history and a pan camera.
notes: Depends on core/audioRibbon and the editor/toolUtilities/(ribbonInput, render/transport, util, style, panCamera) utilities.
Default speed 1.0 (range 0 to 10), default depth 10.0, ray cast up to 10000 m.
onActivate and onDeactivate are local and not exported; they are hooked up via editor.editModes.audioRibbonEditMode.

onInit.desc: Initialization: if core/audioRibbon does not yet have a ribbon list, creates it empty and clears the ribbon names and the near/far lists.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every editor frame: if the mode is active, draws the tool window, displays the ribbons, handles editing (selection, node dragging, gizmo) and drives the pan camera.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the audioRibbonEditMode edit mode (simobject_sfxspace icon) and the "audioRibbonEditor" window (500x500).
